name: Omarchy CN Indicator
author: jfdnet
description: Fcitx5 Chinese input method indicator for the Omarchy top bar: shows EN/中 at a glance and toggles input on click. Works with any fcitx5 engine (Rime, Pinyin, ...). Does not manage fcitx5 or Rime config.

barWidget.description: Fcitx5 EN/中 input method indicator with click-to-toggle
